name: genpark-agentic-rag-hyde-hypothetical-document-generator-skill
description: Agentic RAG HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings) Query Expander. Bridges dense lexical and semantic gaps by generating diverse hypothetical answer passages from sparse user queries to dramatically boost vector search recall.

tools.description: Synthesize hypothetical answer passages across multiple perspectives for zero-shot RAG retrieval.

query.description: Short or sparse user search query.
